maple_leaf.name: Maple leaf
maple_leaf.fact: Maple leaves have five pointy fingers, like a golden star!

oak_leaf.name: Oak leaf
oak_leaf.fact: Oak leaves have wavy edges, and acorns grow on the same tree.

leaf.name: Leaf
leaf.fact: Leaves are little solar panels that turn sunlight into food.

smooth_rock.name: Smooth rock
smooth_rock.fact: Water and wind can polish a rock until it feels like a bar of soap.

rock.name: Rock
rock.fact: Every rock has a story — some are older than the dinosaurs!

flower.name: Flower
flower.fact: Flowers use bright colours and sweet smells to invite bees for a visit.

daisy.name: Daisy
daisy.fact: A daisy's yellow middle is made of hundreds of tiny flowers.

bird.name: Bird
bird.fact: Birds have hollow bones, which helps them fly without being heavy.

robin.name: Robin
robin.fact: Robins can hear a worm moving underground!

bug.name: Bug
bug.fact: Insects have six legs and feel the world with their antennae.

beetle.name: Beetle
beetle.fact: Beetles are the biggest family of animals on Earth.

moss.name: Moss
moss.fact: Moss drinks water straight through its tiny leaves — no roots needed.

fern.name: Fern
fern.fact: Ferns are ancient plants that were around before flowers existed.

feather.name: Feather
feather.fact: A feather is light but strong, and it keeps a bird warm and dry.

tree.name: Tree
tree.fact: Trees talk through their roots, sharing sugar with their neighbours.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.fact: A fluffy cloud is made of tiny water droplets floating in the sky.

acorn.name: Acorn
acorn.fact: A single acorn can grow into an oak tree that lives for hundreds of years.
